newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: World Bank to lend over $1 bln to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to lend over $1 bln to Philippines.

text.p: The World Bank said on Friday it had agreed on an indicative lending programme for the Philippines of over $1 billion during the period July 1997 to June 2000.
The lending programme will cover 18 new projects which will focus on poverty alleviation, infrastructure development and natural resources management, a World Bank statement issued from Manila said.
Besides loans, the World Bank said it also agreed to provide technical assistance in the form of economic and sector analysis, particularly in the areas of rural development, health and energy.
A high-level mission from the Philippine government met with World Bank officials in Washington to agree on the assistance programme to the Philippines.
